prompt: Inside a car at night, close on the steering wheel turning by itself, the driver's hands lifted off it and held up in the air at the edge of frame, the door-lock pin pushed down, the dashboard lights all gone cold white, through the windscreen the car in front lurching forward. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
